name: Battle Of Rovers (Early Access)
detailed_description:
About Battle Of Rovers (Early Access)

Battle Of Rovers (Early Access) is an action-packed, AI-driven multiplayer combat arena where you command highly customizable rovers in intense battles. In the current version, you can select your rover, fine-tune its customization, and jump into multiplayer matchmaking rooms to fight in diverse arenas against other players or AI bots. Every battle tests your strategic thinking, precision, and adaptability as you vie for victory.

Current Features:

  • Rover Selection & Customization:
    Choose your rover and personalize it with a range of weapons, skins, wheels, modules, and visual effects to suit your playstyle.

  • Multiplayer Matchmaking:
    Engage in competitive online matches where you battle against real players or challenging AI bots.

  • Diverse Arenas:
    Fight across a variety of dynamically designed environments—from frozen wastelands to volcanic zones—each offering unique tactical challenges.

  • Strategic Combat:
    Experience fast-paced, skill-based combat with an emphasis on strategy and resource management.

Upcoming Features:

  • User-Driven Asset & Arena Customization:
    Soon, you’ll have the power to design your own assets and arenas, giving you unprecedented control over your gameplay experience.

  • Agent Rovers – "A-GENRO":
    Train your personal battle agent, an AI rover that learns from your playstyle to assist you in combat.

  • Expanded Multiplayer Modes:

    In addition to our competitive battles, we plan to incorporate cooperative multiplayer game modes, allowing players to team up for special missions or challenges.

  • Digg and Add Gameplay:
    Get ready for enhanced digging and adder mechanics that will let you modify the terrain even further—reshaping battlefields and mining resources in innovative ways.

  • Achievements & New Game Modes:
    Unlock achievements and explore fresh game modes, expanding the variety of challenges and rewards available as we continue to develop the game.

Battle Of Rovers (Early Access) is a living project built with the community in mind. Your feedback is crucial in shaping the game’s evolution. Join us now to experience epic battles and help forge the path toward the full release!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 / AMD Radeon HD 7950
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
